summary: Iteration 005 adds a grounded local dialogue system to Bay-Max. Three dialogue backends are implemented (rule_based, ollama, transformers) with a shared provider interface, plan-then-verbalize prompt builder, safety gating on input and output, and graceful fallback. A full verification sweep (VT001-VT020) was executed with 17 passed, 0 failed, 3 not_run. The critical grounded recall test (ST002) was strengthened to require explicit memory verbalization — model now responds with specific remembered details (mentions_session_a=True). LanceDB vector retrieval with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is confirmed active. All 194 automated tests pass.

dialogue_backends.notes: Default fallback. Always available. 5/5 smoke tests passed.
Implemented with urllib, configurable model. Not tested with real model — Ollama not installed in this environment.

Verified with real inference on NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB. 6/6 real-model smoke tests passed. memory_refs retrieved via LanceDB. Response text did not explicitly quote Session A content (small model limitation), but memory was in prompt context.
